scope: Producer search readings; no changes to song aliases, display names, credits or identity IDs.

policy.kana: Generate romanized search forms only for explicitly written kana; transliterations are searchOnly and are not official aliases.
policy.kanji: Accept existing reviewed/VocaDB readings or source-attested Latin/kana; unverified kanji readings remain disabled.
policy.identity: Keep all 526 input IDs. Alias overlap never authorizes automatic identity merging.
policy.handles: An attested official account handle is searchable, but is not asserted to be the full pronunciation of the artist name.
policy.composites: An existing composite credit can be found by an explicitly credited member. This file does not change the producer-credit identity model.
